Derived from the small model's session 1 pair (0.3 in, 2.5 out, EUR per 1M) at a support workload's mix of about 7 input tokens per output token: (7*0.3 + 2.5) / 8 = 0.575, rounded up to 0.6 so the rented side of the build-vs-rent comparison is not flattered.
